# Christopher Bondier

> Christopher Bondier is a full-stack web developer based in Lyon, France, specialized in Angular and Node.js. He is a full-stack development apprentice at UBIKAP and an engineering student at CPE Lyon, currently looking for an internship abroad.

## Profile

- Role: Full-stack developer (Angular, Node.js, TypeScript)
- Location: Lyon, France
- Current: apprentice at UBIKAP, engineering student at CPE Lyon
- Education: CPE Lyon (2025-2028), Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science, IUT Claude Bernard - University Lyon 1 (2022-2025)
- Languages: French (native), English C1 (TOEIC 950)

- [CPE Notes](https://notes.christopher-bondier.com): grade tracking dashboard (Angular, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Playwright)
